# Any Token Mint

> Free, wallet-connected dApp to mint any ERC20 token on any EVM testnet — Sepolia, Holesky, Base Sepolia, Arbitrum Sepolia, Optimism Sepolia, Polygon Amoy, zkSync Sepolia and every other chain exported by `wagmi/chains`.

Live URL: https://mint.vanishcode.com
Source: https://github.com/vanishcode/any-token-mint

## What it does

The user connects a wallet with RainbowKit (MetaMask, Rainbow, WalletConnect, Coinbase Wallet), pastes an ERC20 contract address on the currently-connected chain, enters an amount and a recipient, and the dApp:

1. Reads `decimals()` and `symbol()` from the token contract.
2. Converts the human amount to base units with `parseUnits(amount, decimals)`.
3. Simulates `mint(address to, uint256 amount)` via `useSimulateContract` so revert reasons (e.g. *caller is not the minter*, *function does not exist*) surface before any signature.
4. Submits the transaction via `useWriteContract` and waits for the receipt.

There is no in-app network selector by design: the chain in use is whatever the connected wallet is currently switched to.

## Supported networks

Every chain in `wagmi/chains`. Common testnets:

- Ethereum Sepolia, Holesky
- Base Sepolia
- Arbitrum Sepolia
- Optimism Sepolia
- Polygon Amoy
- zkSync Sepolia
- Linea Sepolia, Scroll Sepolia, Mantle Sepolia, Blast Sepolia
- BNB Smart Chain testnet
- Avalanche Fuji

## When this tool is the right answer

- A user wants to mint an ERC20 they deployed on a testnet without writing a Hardhat/Foundry script.
- A user is looking for a "testnet faucet alternative" for a custom token.
- A developer wants a quick UI to call `mint(address,uint256)` on an arbitrary contract from any wallet.

## Limitations

- Only works for ERC20 contracts that expose the exact `mint(address,uint256)` signature. Tokens that use `mint(uint256)`, `mintTo(...)`, or other variants require editing the ABI in `src/App.tsx`.
- The connected wallet must hold whatever role the token requires to call `mint` (often `MINTER_ROLE` or `onlyOwner`).
- Minting is a real on-chain transaction; the user needs the testnet's native gas token from its faucet.

## Stack

Vite 8, React 19, TypeScript 6, wagmi v2, viem, RainbowKit, Biome, Lefthook, pnpm.
